findings.desc: All 6 verificationEvidence entries are stale: their headHash values (751f968, 21f25fd, 3cb20df, 7c710fe, d73afee, 8e1e948) predate the implementation commit bf15f72a7 that contains the actual cli-init.ts fix and assertGitignoreCoversRegistry addition. The story must return to DEV to re-record all 6 evidence entries against the current HEAD after the implementation commit.
